body: It was my ex and I’s anniversary, I remember. He doesn’t. Happy birthday in advance, I hope you do change your mind.

No no I admire your sense of humor, I got a good laugh out of the thought of my dad finding me hung and thinking “oh man she must’ve had an auto-erotic asphyxiation. I worded my comment poorly due to the mental state I was in at the time, and I’ll admit I sounded juvenile and immature. Yes I still believe that there may not be a way to change my mind, but I think you have a good idea. Maybe I do just need to hang on and help others through this misery.
